commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== BASELINE: boot id and module state =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "-- lsmod before --"
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "usb_storage not currently loaded"

echo "== STEP 1: blacklist module (persist across reboot) =="
sudo -n tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
blacklist usb-storage
install usb-storage /bin/false
EOF
cat /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf

echo "== STEP 2: unload module now if loaded =="
if lsmod | grep -qi '^usb_storage'; then
  sudo -n modprobe -r usb_storage
else
  echo "already not loaded, skipping rmmod"
fi

echo "== STEP 3: verify modprobe refuses to load it =="
sudo -n modprobe usb-storage 2>&1 || echo "modprobe blocked as expected (exit $?)"

echo "== STEP 4: rebuild initramfs so blacklist applies at early boot too =="
if command -v dracut >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n dracut -f
elif command -v update-initramfs >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n update-initramfs -u
else
  echo "no initramfs tool found, skipping"
fi

echo "== VERIFY: post-change state =="
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "usb_storage confirmed not loaded"
sudo -n modprobe -c 2>/dev/null | grep -i "blacklist usb-storage" || echo "checking via modprobe -c not conclusive, relying on config file"
echo "-- config file listing --"
ls -l /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf
echo "DONE"
